integrity.independent_numerical_evidence: Standalone moment ODE and symbolic checks; finite tests do not prove global assertions.
integrity.proof_basis: Affine second-moment dynamics, strict hyperbolic suppression inequality, uniform small-period expansion, compactness of all normalized maximizers.

scientific_limitations: A two-contact equal-duration classical overdamped Otto protocol with constant stiffness in each stage, instantaneous zero resets, and strictly engine-ordered bath/stiffness parameters; only quench mechanical work, not reset-actuator cost, is optimized. Claim is asymptotic as stage length goes to zero; no finite-stage uniqueness or net efficiency statement.
title: A two-thirds fast-cycle law for optimal resetting in a Brownian Otto protocol
